%str1%! Are you off to find adventure? Is your Wyld Hunt song pounding in your ears?
%str1%! I heard you and Aurene were here, so I followed the Crystal Bloom to join you. These halls are legendary. And a good place to make your own.
%str1%! Still upright and kicking, eh? Howl charged ahead, as usual. His impatience is gonna get him a knife in the back someday. Not my knife...probably. Unless someone steals my knife.
%str1%! Yes, yes, happy to see you here. You helped so much, showed how to fight fire-trolls. Yes, we can do it. Many thanks and many shinies for you, yes!
%str1%'s message box is full. Your message couldn't be sent.
%str1%, it is nice to see you again. Hope you've been well. Care to trade any excess items for shinies?
%str1%, we of the Durmand Priory can't thank you enough for your contribution. You will be remembered.

%str1%,

I'm well aware of just how busy you are. However, you've heard the theories that Scarlet disturbed one of the dragons. I fear these theories have merit.

My eyes and ears in Brisban Wildlands are reporting mysterious incursions into previously quiet areas. Go see for yourself. I hope your curiosity will spur you to action.

—E

%str1%,

Your visit gave me a lot to think about. It's more dangerous away from the Grove than I ever expected, and I'd been considering going back. But now, I've seen how brave souls help others—like you helped us—and it's given me the courage to carry on. Thank you. Good luck with your future journeys.

—Mavad
%str1%. I send you respectful regards and appreciation for your assistance with my scouts. You came at exactly the right moment. —Vigil Tactician Tunelle
%str1%. I'm sorry you had to see that. I'd help him if I could, you know?
%str1%: (chuckles) More moths to flame, sizzling with melancholy as they reach my ember...
%str1%: All I see is another opportunity to turn breathing flesh to paste. I welcome them.
%str1%: And which of your groveling toadies did you hide behind? I KNOW you didn't fight them yourself!
%str1%: Back, Sister, back! You'll be turned to scree if your willfulness moves your legs before your mind can catch up.
%str1%: Choking on the weight of my own dejection...
%str1%: Close your eyes and feel the emptiness wash over you.
%str1%: Darkness is a blessing. Close your eyes, and feel it wash over you.
%str1%: Decima, be more thoughtful with your energy.
%str1%: Decima, they slither toward us with venom on fang! Watch yourself.
%str1%: Fascinating is your dedication to dying plots. I will turn this swamp to rot.
%str1%: Foolish tricks will only speed your march to death!
%str1%: I don't want to hurt you. Please...stop me...!
%str1%: I think not. But spill no tear; your bravery is excellent.
%str1%: I will compensate for the delusion of my kin. Your "bloodstone" ripples through my every essence.
%str1%: I've looked foolish in the eye; I see none behind yours. Retreat, and so shall we.
%str1%: If you don't all want to die...kill me now!
%str1%: If you don't get over here RIGHT NOW, I'll tell her all about it.
%str1%: In the beginning there was only emptiness...and now you must join it.
%str1%: Is that what has my darlings all riled up? A few fleas got into my nest?
%str1%: Look...the world is ending. A landscape of shattered dreams and death. And all due to...me.
%str1%: My kin seem to favor you, and I can sense why.
%str1%: My thanks to you for keeping my kin company. I hope you found as much benefit in it as they did.
%str1%: NOW, you lazy slug! I can smell your rot from here! How did I get stuck with a selfish pissant for a brother?
%str1%: Oh, look how small they are! All the way down there. So cute and miniscule...
%str1%: Please, no more of this! It's poisoning me.
%str1%: Please...leave here...before you are all destroyed...
%str1%: Reach deep inside, and you will feel the emptiness already growing there.
%str1%: So sweet is the honey on your lips, just before his talons catch victory by the throat.
%str1%: The end is the beginning, and the beginning will be nothingness.
%str1%: The end will come fast, and death will be your deliverance.
%str1%: The multiplicity of your bestial nature flickers dull without air... I am Greer. And you are small.
%str1%: The pain... It's too much to bear!
%str1%: Their emotional fortifications will end us if we don't rip that hope directly from their coiled fingers...
%str1%: There is an ocean of Void, and you are already drowning in it.
%str1%: There is only Void...there is only Void...there is only—(gasp) I...I can feel its grip loosening!
%str1%: To me, godspawn. Do not let your stubbornness and lust for dominion win.
%str1%: Together. We'll crush them beneath us; pull their bodies through the Mists until nothing remains but essence and memory.
%str1%: Void is all that is and all that must be.
%str1%: WHO DARES DISTURB THE DEN OF THE GREAT DECIMA—
%str1%: We are all godspawn, but I am Ura. And I am far stronger than my stock.
%str1%: Well, we can't have that. It's unclean. I'll just have to show them...
%str1%: What do we do when pests sneak into our home?
%str1%: You cannot avoid the undertow pulling you toward nothingness.
%str1%: You have done well to find us.
%str1%: You will join us now, and all will be as one.
%str1%: Your challenge is but a flicker in a sea of darkness... A darkness that awaits you.
%str1%: Your desires are but a mirage, and behind them lurks oblivion.
%str1%: Your hesitation will get us killed.
